title: Mandatory security upgrade to v2.0.0
summary: Mandatory security upgrade of medasdigital-2 to medasdigitald v2.0.0 (upgrade name v2) at height 10273674, expected around Monday, 5 October 2026, 14:00 UTC. v2.0.0 updates Cosmos SDK to v0.50.15, CometBFT to v0.38.26, wasmd to v0.54.10 (wasmvm v2.2.9) and ibc-go to v8.8.0. v1.0.1 stops at the upgrade height, and every validator and full node must switch to v2.0.0 there. Release binary: https://github.com/oxygene76/medasdigital-2/releases/tag/v2.0.0 (sha256 4df5db896514dc9795173274ec745dc73b630c90082960b96aad75b508b99bba). Instructions: https://github.com/oxygene76/medasdigital-2/blob/main/docs/upgrades/v2.md. Nodes set up with medasdigital_setup.sh: nodes without Cosmovisor run 'sudo ./medasdigital_setup.sh migrate' first, then every node runs 'sudo ./medasdigital_setup.sh prepare-upgrade v2' before the upgrade height; Cosmovisor then switches automatically.
